Last week, Apple kicked off a new round of testing for its 27.2 series of software. Just five days later, systems including iPadOS 27.2 have now pushed out their beta 2 updates.

iPadOS 27.2 receives beta 2 update, covering tvOS 27.2, visionOS 27.2, and more

For Apple, the past week or so has been a period of frequent releases.

The company officially rolled out major updates including iOS 27, iPadOS 27, and macOS Golden Gate to the public last Monday. Several days later, developer beta 1 of the 27.2 series made its debut.

Skipping 27.1 came as a surprise, but reports indicate it will be exclusive to the iPhone Duo.

Apple has therefore jumped straight to 27.2 for testers to try out. The most notable new features in iPadOS 27.2 and related versions include:

  • Apple TV personal profiles arrive on iPhone and iPad
  • A revamped, upgraded Health app
  • Siri AI supports more languages
  • A Siri feature previously exclusive to Mac comes to iPad

Today, systems including iPadOS 27.2, watchOS 27.2, and tvOS 27.2 have all begun pushing beta 2.

With beta 1 released only five days ago, this update is not expected to bring many major changes, instead focusing on bug fixes and performance optimisation, with possible addition of a few smaller new features.

Have you installed beta 2 of iPadOS 27.2 or any of the other systems? Feel free to share any new features you've discovered in the comments.
